programs.sub_title: 2023 - 761st Tank Battalion: The Original Black Panthers
programs.desc: (MA) Featuring Morgan Freeman, this powerful documentary reveals the true story of WWII's first Black tank unit. It explores the major battles they faced both overseas and at home.
